# prompt-flamegraph

> Lightweight, zero-dependency Python package to profile LLM prompt tokens with interactive flamegraphs, waste detection, prompt diffs and HTML/SVG/Markdown/JSON/terminal exports.

prompt-flamegraph takes a structured prompt (system prompt, tools, RAG context, chat history) or a raw OpenAI/Anthropic payload and shows where the tokens go in an interactive flamegraph. No proxy, no server, no dashboard, no telemetry. One function call, one output file.

- Install: `pip install prompt-flamegraph`
- Python 3.10+, LGPL-3.0-or-later, zero required dependencies
- Optional extras: `tiktoken` for accurate OpenAI-style counts, `rich` for prettier terminal output
- Current version: 0.3.0
- API: `profile_prompt()`, `diff_prompts()`, `detect_waste()`, `build_tree()`, `count_tokens()`, `normalize()`, `from_messages()`, `from_langchain()`, `from_litellm_messages()`, `profile_any()`
- CLI: `prompt-flamegraph prompt.json -o context.html`, `--format html|svg|md|json`, `--terminal`, `--diff`, `--demo`, `--cost`, `--tokenizer`, `--model`, `--list-models`, `--update-models`, `--offline`, `--budget`, `--no-aggregate`; stdin input via `-`
- Model-aware profiling: `--model gpt-4o` derives tokenizer encoding, pricing and context window; `--update-models` refreshes LiteLLM community pricing into a local cache (community estimates), `--offline`/`PROMPT_FLAMEGRAPH_OFFLINE` keeps it bundled-only
- CI budget gate: `--budget TOKENS` exits with code 3 when the prompt exceeds the budget; example workflow at `.github/workflows/prompt-budget.yml.example`
- Aggregation: thin nodes fold into `· N more ·` buckets; `--no-aggregate` / `aggregate=False` draws everything
